title: Iron & Ash Expansion
description: Expand your world with cooperative firearms! Craft balanced guns, unlock achievements, and fight PvE threats alone or together with friends.
body:
# Iron & Ash Expansion

Enhance your Minecraft journey with a powerful, functional arsenal of firearms! The **Iron & Ash Expansion** introduces a brand-new selection of ranged weapons, tailored for apocalyptic survival or hardcore combat. From high-precision rifles to devastating flamethrowers, this datapack brings true firepower to your game.

---

## ⚒️ How it Works

* **Crafting:** Combine vanilla resources to forge these new firearms. The recipes are intuitive and will automatically appear in your vanilla crafting table. 
  - The ammunition type is shown if you hover over the item.
  - To reload, **simply** sneak while holding your gun in your hand and having the ammunition in your inventory.
  
  ![This image shows all new items.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1a5b20c6ed62907e61c95c7009cd990066c8cc23.png)

* **Advancements:** Track your achievements as a master gunsmith with a custom set of in-game advancements.

  ![This image shows all new advancements.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/28d2c99a2299049ca49fccf5101ddbf6a99c5d27.png)

---

## 💎 Featured Firearms

Here is a full showcase of the newly added ranged weapons and their tactical uses:

<details>
<summary>🔍 Spoilers (Click to preview Weapon Stats & Details)</summary>
  
### Weapon Stats & Capabilities

* **Revolver:** Compact, quick to draw, and ideal for tight situations in close-quarters combat.
  
  ![This image shows the revolver model.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/361044b3c59bc84df06e520e9782aec403849dc5_0.webp)
  ![This image shows the revolver stats.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/41a5476b407326e926ac524a20cdcb047dcedb62.png)

* **Rifle:** Very reliable at medium range. Delivers solid damage and good accuracy for everyday combat encounters.
  
  ![This image shows the rifle model.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/32dd98048e56503e8352501245077a079585fada_0.webp)
  ![This image shows the rifle stats.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5b10be46a03052afa98c9e08c2adaace3f2be310.png)

* **Rifle (Bayonet):** Highly reliable at medium and melee range. Delivers solid damage and good accuracy for everyday combat encounters.
  
  ![This image shows the rifle (bayonet) model.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/39faf851801ecc9d4d7075ebe50fcf9a271f4636_0.webp)
  ![This image shows the rifle (bayonet) stats.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/002b4dce4e363f5843eec8ba893f7f0452e057ce.png)

* **Sniper:** Maximum range and extremely high damage per shot, but requires a long reload time. Perfect for ambushes.
    - Note: This weapon can only be fired while/with sneaking. You can right-click to zoom, just like using a spyglass.
  
  ![This image shows the sniper model.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/802ab9e671c40eb938493d590be983a1abfedc43.png)
  ![This image shows the sniper stats.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/084706ace27df626545f2a5128229bd9e645134a.png)

* **Shotgun:** Devastating burst damage at close range. Leaves enemies with no chance in tight spaces.
  
  ![This image shows the shotgun model.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/25c06e75466d2fa3e2a9136c00d17d4b22d5381b.png)
  ![This image shows the shotgun stats.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ba6dec207d33413a6a2f2efa24203a1e9020a7f8.png)

* **Flamethrower:** Sets entire groups of enemies and areas ablaze. Consumes fuel rapidly but offers ultimate battlefield control.
  
  ![This image shows the flamethrower model.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2ca54a852dbcb6c8f2f4f82e57f9f30db47e3f56_0.webp)
  ![This image shows the flamethrower stats.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f213e2b9cf32a51e5cb5891abd48e408285a6c5e.png)

* **Boost Cannon:** Shoots wind charges that can help you get onto higher areas or shoot your enemies down from platforms. Offers more control over the battlefield.
  
  ![This image shows the boost cannon model.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/62b75c00b078c08a151adfd5bac6204de61056b8_0.webp)
  ![This image shows the boost cannon stats.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/819ce2405bc6ac3e9090e75c95a2e685fd13bc84.png)

* **Grenades:** Throw grenades that can **explode**, set the ground on fire, or create a smoke cloud.
  
  ![This image shows the grenade stats.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/db3514a3584f2a14801ae560d73889d2545661b7.png)
  
  ![This image shows the fire grenade stats.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/30dd9caa5adbfd2aa56852a6ba8386173fdf5231.png)
  
  ![This image shows the smoke grenade stats.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e1e7dd141092f4de32b89c6826c18721e3edb427.png)

</details>

---

## ⚠️ IMPORTANT REQUIREMENTS

This datapack **requires** its corresponding Resource Pack to display textures and 3D models correctly. Without it, items will appear as default vanilla objects or broken textures.

---

## 🛠️ Installation
1. **Datapack:** Place the `.zip` file into your `world/datapacks` folder.
2. **Resource Pack:** Place the `.zip` file into your `resourcepacks` folder and enable it in the in-game settings.

* 💡 Note: Ensure you download both files. You can find them under the **Versions** tab inside your preferred release.

---

## ⚙️ Compatibility & Technical Notes

* **Multiplayer / Server Support:** Fully compatible with multiplayer environments! Please note that **Friendly Fire is disabled** by design. This expansion is built for cooperative PvE gameplay, allowing you and your friends to fight together as a team against monsters without harming each other.
* **Datapack Compatibility:** Fully compatible with my other Expansion Datapacks.
* **🚨 NOTE FOR ADMINS:** Most of these firearms utilize a vanilla `Carrot on a Stick` combined with a custom `item_model`. 
  - Please exercise caution with custom plugins or mods that alter handheld item interactions or click behaviors for the `Carrot on a Stick` to prevent potential player exploits or visual glitches.
